name: io.github.ByteBunny-io/nanocart-mcp
description: Manage your NanoCart store from any AI agent: products, orders, coupons, subscribers, reports.

environmentVariables.name: NANOCART_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Your NanoCart Admin API key (portal.nanocart.io -> Settings -> API Keys)

environmentVariables.name: NANOCART_STORE_ID
environmentVariables.description: Your store ID / slug (portal.nanocart.io -> Settings -> Store Information)

headers.name: X-Store-Id
headers.description: Your store ID (or append ?store=your-store-id to the URL)
